prompt: Create an e-commerce UGC talking-head video for this beverage. A young, influencer-style woman should appear on camera to showcase and introduce the product to an international audience. The flavor is Mango Passionfruit.

promptTranslations.en: Create an e-commerce UGC talking-head video for this beverage. A young, influencer-style woman should appear on camera to showcase and introduce the product to an international audience. The flavor is Mango Passionfruit.
promptTranslations.zh: 为这款饮品制作一段电商 UGC 口播视频。一位年轻的网红风女性应出现在镜头前，向国际受众展示并介绍该产品。口味为芒果百香果味。
promptTranslations.zh-TW: 為這款飲品製作一段電商 UGC 口播影片。一位年輕的網紅風女性應出現在鏡頭前，向國際觀眾展示並介紹該產品。口味為芒果百香果味。
promptTranslations.ja-JP: この飲料のEコマース向けUGCトーキングヘッド動画を作成してください。インフルエンサー風の若い女性がカメラの前に登場し、海外の視聴者に向けて商品を紹介・アピールします。フレーバーはマンゴーパッションフルーツです。
promptTranslations.ko-KR: 이 음료를 위한 이커머스 UGC 토킹헤드 영상을 제작하세요. 인플루언서 스타일의 젊은 여성이 카메라에 등장하여 해외 시청자에게 제품을 선보이고 소개해야 합니다. 맛은 망고 패션프루트입니다.
promptTranslations.th-TH: สร้างวิดีโอ UGC แบบพูดย่อหน้ากล้อง (talking-head) สำหรับอีคอมเมิร์ซของเครื่องดื่มนี้ ผู้หญิงรุ่นใหม่สไตล์อินฟลูเอนเซอร์ควรปรากฏตัวหน้ากล้องเพื่อโชว์และแนะนำผลิตภัณฑ์ให้กับผู้ชมทั่วโลก รสชาติคือมะม่วงเสาวรส
promptTranslations.vi-VN: Tạo một video UGC nói chuyện trước ống kính (talking-head) thương mại điện tử cho loại đồ uống này. Một phụ nữ trẻ mang phong cách influencer sẽ xuất hiện trước ống kính để giới thiệu và quảng bá sản phẩm tới khán giả quốc tế. Hương vị là Xoài Chanh Leo.
promptTranslations.hi-IN: इस पेय के लिए एक ई-कॉमर्स UGC टॉकिंग-हेड वीडियो बनाएं। अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दर्शकों के सामने उत्पाद को प्रदर्शित और प्रस्तुत करने के लिए एक युवा, प्रभावशाली (इन्फ्लुएंसर) शैली की महिला कैमरे पर दिखाई देनी चाहिए। स्वाद मैंगो पैशनफ्रूट है।
promptTranslations.es-ES: Crea un vídeo UGC de busto parlante para comercio electrónico de esta bebida. Una mujer joven con estilo de influencer debe aparecer en cámara para mostrar y presentar el producto a una audiencia internacional. El sabor es Mango Maracuyá.
promptTranslations.es-419: Crea un video UGC de plano medio corto (talking-head) para comercio electrónico de esta bebida. Una mujer joven con estilo de influencer debe aparecer en cámara para mostrar y presentar el producto a una audiencia internacional. El sabor es Mango Maracuyá.
promptTranslations.de-DE: Erstelle ein E-Commerce-UGC-Talking-Head-Video für dieses Getränk. Eine junge Frau im Influencer-Stil soll vor der Kamera auftreten, um das Produkt einem internationalen Publikum zu präsentieren und vorzustellen. Die Geschmacksrichtung ist Mango-Passionsfrucht.
promptTranslations.fr-FR: Créez une vidéo UGC face caméra de type e-commerce pour cette boisson. Une jeune femme au style influenceuse doit apparaître à l'écran pour présenter et faire découvrir le produit à un public international. La saveur est Mangue Fruit de la Passion.
promptTranslations.it-IT: Crea un video UGC in formato talking-head per l'e-commerce di questa bevanda. Una giovane donna in stile influencer dovrebbe apparire davanti alla telecamera per mostrare e presentare il prodotto a un pubblico internazionale. Il gusto è Mango e Frutto della Passione.
promptTranslations.pt-BR: Crie um vídeo UGC falando para a câmera (talking-head) de e-commerce para esta bebida. Uma jovem mulher em estilo influenciadora deve aparecer na câmera para exibir e apresentar o produto a um público internacional. O sabor é Manga com Maracujá.
promptTranslations.pt-PT: Crie um vídeo UGC em estilo talking-head para comércio eletrónico desta bebida. Uma jovem mulher com estilo de influenciadora deve aparecer na câmara para mostrar e apresentar o produto a um público internacional. O sabor é Manga e Maracujá.
promptTranslations.tr-TR: Bu içecek için e-ticarete yönelik bir UGC doğrudan kameraya konuşma (talking-head) videosu oluşturun. Ürünü uluslararası bir kitleye sergilemek ve tanıtmak için influencer tarzında genç bir kadın ekranda görünmelidir. Lezzet Mango Çarkıfelek Meyvesi.

post.originalText:
Turned a simple beverage idea into a polished UGC-style product video using @Kling_ai MCP.

I created an influencer-style host to showcase a Mango Passionfruit beverage, complete with product presentation, narration, and background music — all from a simple workflow.

Instead of building each element separately, Kling MCP helped turn a basic concept into ready-to-use promotional content.

A practical example of how MCP can simplify the entire creative process from prompt to finished product video.

Prompt used:
“Create an e-commerce UGC talking-head video for this beverage. A young, influencer-style woman should appear on camera to showcase and introduce the product to an international audience. The flavor is Mango Passionfruit.”
